text: This bun has no cut anywhere… so how did the cream get inside?
sayTts: [mischievously] This bun has no cut anywhere... so how did the cream get inside?

text: In one minute you'll know how, why they never fill it before baking, and how to spot it in your own bun.
sayTts: [playfully] In one minute you'll know how, why they never fill it before baking... and how to spot it in your own bun.

text: In the oven, the dough rises and the inside fills with tiny air pockets.
sayTts: [curious] In the oven, the dough rises... and the inside fills with tiny air pockets.

text: Then the needle goes in: a steel tube that pierces the bun without tearing it.
sayTts: [dramatic] Then the needle goes in: a steel tube that pierces the bun... without tearing it.

text: Behind it, a piston measures every shot to the gram: 15 grams, every single time.
say: Behind it, a piston measures every shot to the gram: fifteen grams, every single time.
sayTts: [amazed] Behind it, a piston measures every shot to the gram: fifteen grams, every single time!

text: But that's not the crazy part.
sayTts: [excited] But that's... not the crazy part.

text: Why not fill it first? Because cream can't survive the oven: it would melt and burn.
sayTts: [thoughtful] Why not fill it first? Because cream can't survive the oven: it would melt... and burn.

text: So they wait for the bun to cool down… and only then do they stab it.
sayTts: [dramatic] So they wait for the bun to cool down... and only then, do they stab it.

text: Grab your bun and look for a tiny dot: that's where the needle went in.
sayTts: [curious] Grab your bun and look for a tiny dot: that's where the needle went in.

text: See more than one? They hit it several times so the cream reaches every corner.
sayTts: [chuckles] See more than one? They hit it several times... so the cream reaches every corner.

text: Noticed that? You'll never look at a bun the same way again.
sayTts: [warmly] Noticed that? You'll never look at a bun the same way again.

text: Comment «CREAM» and I'll DM you how to fill them at home.
sayTts: [excited] Comment cream... and I'll DM you how to fill them at home.

cta.reply: Here you go: fill them at home!

text: And follow for more about what you eat.
sayTts: [warmly] And follow for more about what you eat.
